requirement_evidence.evidence: Verified dispositions and receipt existence for all 40 tasks (W4-001 through W4-040). Verified no circular dependencies and zero missing required outputs.
Recomputed all SHA-256 hashes, counters (5,053 queries, 3,572 supervised), 17 method rows, 24 hypotheses (14 supported, 9 falsified, 1 not established), and verified strict PDF/source binding.
Ran full delivery verification regression and checked preservation of 214 protected files with exact hash matches. Did not overwrite old receipts.

Accurately recorded R=0 useful streaming coverage for regional verifiers (M05-M13) while retaining 100% agreement (D_all=0) via fail-closed fallback. Retained negative speedup findings honestly without claiming unproven eligibility.
Published canonical CLOSEOUT.md mapping requirement -> output -> evidence -> status, with exact file paths, exit codes, hashes, and scientific limitations.

Updated GATES.md, GATES_EN.md, and navigation READMEs strictly aligned with reviewed empirical evidence. Documented G2 HOLD, G3 FALSIFIED_STREAMING, G4 FALSIFIED_CPU, and G5 NOT_ESTABLISHED based on measured metrics rather than task count.
Clearly demarcated Engineering Status (COMPLETE 100%) from Scientific Findings (AUTHENTIC_NEGATIVE_RESULTS: H14, H19, H20, H24). Left User Acceptance unassumed.
No unauthorized git commits, pushes, branches, or deployments were performed. Working directory state is cleanly audited and ready for review.

limitations: Final scientific user acceptance is reserved for the project committee and human user.
Hardware speedups on specialized ASICs/GPUs or modified CNN architectures with higher operational intensity remain deferred for future research.
